title: MagNav.jl quickstart: Tolles-Lawson and EKF on the SGL 2020 flight
summary: A Julia walkthrough with MagNav.jl that downloads the public SGL 2020 challenge flight and Ottawa anomaly maps, compensates the scalar magnetometer with Tolles-Lawson on a calibration box, and runs the MagNav EKF against the map, printing INS-only vs EKF error and the CRLB. The README explains why magnetic anomaly navigation resists jamming and spoofing, and where it breaks down (map coverage, altitude, aircraft noise, temporal variation).
verified: Ran on 2026-11-06 in the julia:1.11 Docker image (Julia 1.11.9, linux/arm64) with MagNav.jl v1.3.5, CSV v1.3.0, DataFrames v1.8.2 and FFTA pinned to 0.2.1 (FFTA 0.3.2 breaks precompilation of GlobalSensitivity): EKF DRMS 31.2 m vs INS-only final error 218.8 m on line 1006.08 with map Eastern_395. Output in README. Artifacts downloaded: sgl_2020_train ~563 MB and ottawa_area_maps ~1.2 GB on disk, plus EMAG2 ~0.5 GB pulled during precompile.
first_command: docker exec magnav sh -c 'cd /work && JULIA_NUM_THREADS=1 julia --heap-size-hint=2500M --project=/work /sample/magnav_quickstart.jl /examples'
